stem: What is the most likely reason the poet includes the details in lines 21 through 28 of the poem “The World Is at My Fingertips”?

options.label: A
options.text: To demonstrate how the speaker’s aunt faced difficult challenges in the past

options.label: B
options.text: To give thanks for the technology people used throughout history

options.label: C
options.text: To provide an example of how people can change by talking with others

options.label: D
options.text: To show the speaker’s awareness of how new technology has changed daily life
